<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אלול_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920412_theRebbe_962" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_9C_D7_95_D7_9C_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920412_theRebbe_962__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section is a placeholder with an asterisk.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the verse "Kumi Ori" means Israel must shine because their light has already arrived, and connects this to the Midrash about the Menorah and the verse "For with You is the source of life; in Your light we see light."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">"Arise, shine, for your light has come..."</t>
    <t s="1">Now,</t>
    <t s="2">"for your light has come" is the reason for "Arise, shine."</t>
    <t s="3">That the Holy One, blessed be He, says to Israel,</t>
    <t s="4">Since your light has already come,</t>
    <t s="5">the light of yours</t>
    <t s="6">(of Israel),</t>
    <t s="7">therefore you need to arise and shine.</t>
    <t s="8">And one must understand what is the concept of these two lights,</t>
    <t s="9">the light of Israel themselves and the light that they need to shine.</t>
    <t s="10">And this will be understood by means of what is brought in the Yalkut,</t>
    <t s="11">Israel said before the Holy One, blessed be He,</t>
    <t s="12">We made a Menorah for You in the days of Moshe and it was extinguished,</t>
    <t s="13">in the days of Shlomo and it was extinguished,</t>
    <t s="14">from now on we await only Your light,</t>
    <t s="15">as it is stated,</t>
    <t s="16">"For with You is the source of life; in Your light we see light,"</t>
    <t s="17">and so the Holy One, blessed be He, said, "Arise, shine, for your light has come."</t>
    <t s="18">And from the fact that they compare "Arise, shine, for your light has come" to "in Your light we see light,"</t>
    <t s="19">it is understood,</t>
    <t s="20">that the two concepts in the verse "Arise, shine, for your light has come" are analogous to the two concepts in the verse "in Your light we see light."</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains the four levels in the verse "For with You is the source of life; in Your light we see light" — life, source of life, Your light, and light — in ascending order from the lowest to the highest.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">2)</t>
    <t s="1">And this will be understood by prefacing what is explained by my revered father-in-law, the Rebbe, in his maamar beginning "For with You is the source of life; in Your light we see light,"</t>
    <t s="2">that in this verse there are four concepts.</t>
    <t s="3">Life,</t>
    <t s="4">source of life,</t>
    <t s="5">Your light, and light.</t>
    <t s="6">And these four concepts are in order from below upward.</t>
    <t s="7">"Life" is the G-dly vitality that is invested in the worlds,</t>
    <t s="8">filling all worlds.</t>
    <t s="9">[And one may add an explanation,</t>
    <t s="10">that this which is called by the name "life" is in the plural,</t>
    <t s="11">because the vitality that is invested in the worlds and creations is in a multiplicity of divisions,</t>
    <t s="12">in each creation according to its concept.]</t>
    <t s="13">"Source of life" is the light that encompasses all worlds.</t>
    <t s="14">"Your light" is Torah,</t>
    <t s="15">Torah is light,</t>
    <t s="16">which is above even the encompassing [light].</t>
    <t s="17">And the "light" that is seen through "Your light" is above even "Your light,"</t>
    <t s="18">to the extent that "Your light" is only a preparation for the light that is seen through it.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
